description.value: VBM8/SPM8 gray-matter asymmetry processing using symmetric DARTEL normalization and modulation.

spans.text: The gray matter asymmetry analysis was carried out following the protocol by Kurth et al. 11 , which includes modifications to the standard VBM workflow 3 to optimize the accurate detection of gray matter asymmetry.

value: VBM8
SPM8
DARTEL

spans.text: The high-resolution 3D T1-weighted images were analyzed using the VBM8 toolbox

value: segmentation into gray matter and white matter
flipping gray and white matter segments
warping original and flipped gray matter segments to a symmetric DARTEL template
modulation using the Jacobian determinant

spans.text: First, T1 images were segmented into separate gray matter and white matter. Then, the gray and white matter segments were flipped to create a symmetric DARTEL 12 template. For each participant, the original and flipped gray matter segments were warped to this symmetric DARTEL template. Finally, the modulation was applied by multiplying the normalized gray matter segments with the Jacobian determinant from the deformation matrix to correct the confounding effect of variance induced by individual whole-brain size.
The resulting AI images were then spatially smoothed with a Gaussian kernel of 8 mm×8 mm×8 mm full-width at half-maximum.
Finally, a voxel-wise two-sample t -test was performed within a right-hemispheric gray matter mask to test differences in the AI between AD patients and healthy controls controlling for age.
